revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent and their share of operating expenses under leases.
revenueModel.evidence: However, most of our leases include contractual rent escalations and require tenants to pay their share of operating expenses, including common area maintenance, real estate taxes, and insurance, which help mitigate inflationary impacts on costs and operating expenses.
